ELIXIR_VERSION.description: Specific version of elixir to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

ELIXIR_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install ELIXIR. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.
